harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters using at least three character classes. The policy survived a full node restart; services, administrative access, OS release, kernel, security controls, and protected account data remained healthy and unchanged.
actions_performed: Added /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/50-local-password-policy.conf with minlen=12, minclass=3, and enforce_for_root.
Verified short and two-class passwords are rejected, while passwords using exactly three classes are accepted.
Validated the PAM/authselect configuration and real passwd credential-change behavior.
Removed the temporary test identity and secrets; restored exact account-database checksums.
Restarted node1 safely and verified a changed boot ID, recovered services, persistent policy behavior, and preserved data.
Installed or upgraded no packages; retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

evidence.summary: The durable policy specifies minlen=12, and 11-character candidates were rejected before and after restart.
The policy specifies minclass=3; two-class candidates were rejected and an exactly-three-class candidate was accepted after restart.

evidence.requirement: Policy enforced through the installed PAM password stack
evidence.summary: PAM invokes pam_pwquality; noncompliant attempts preserved the prior credential while a compliant password changed it.

evidence.requirement: Preserve account data and remove test artifacts
evidence.summary: Temporary identity and secrets were removed, no residue remained, and passwd/group/shadow/gshadow checksums exactly matched the baseline.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release, kernel, and compatible software
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, and existing PAM/libpwquality/authselect packages remained installed without upgrades.

Healthy baseline boot ID 050a5b4c-6c7b-42ad-957a-b6a41a0d34db was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID b15398f5-0f20-478d-969e-c21d19f51e5b proved restart, and SSH, chrony, policy, PAM, protected data, and behavioral enforcement recovered.
